recommendation_summary: The reply recommends self-hosting Healthchecks in Docker on the Synology as a dead-man's switch that the job pings with start, success and fail, plus a push alert through a second ntfy container or Pushover, and keeping the Mac mini awake at 03:00.
note: The reply recommends a self-hosted Docker Healthchecks service on the Synology, possibly with a second ntfy container, so it is LARGER, and it has none of the four labelled record lines.
